authority: Single deterministic subprocess persists selected generation, publisher term/permit, durable reader pins and retiring/tombstone state in one envelope. Process-held exclusive byte lock admits one authority. Restart increments writer term and preserves reader pins.
reader_rights: New pins bind current selected generation/revision; existing admitted pins may finish their immutable old generation after publication. Logical retirement blocks new admission, not existing pinned rights.
reclamation: Reclaim only noncurrent generation with zero durable pins; persist retiring intent before deletion; restart resumes an explicitly enumerated idempotent cleanup. Never infer reader death from elapsed time.
trust_boundary: Controller-owned IPC and observed child handle death are fixture authority. No production identity, OS ACL or malicious raw-filesystem writer protection.
alternatives: Drain-before-publish serializes publication after all pins drain; pinned-generation permits new publication while old pins retain generation. Transactional store mapping remains a later comparison, not a selected implementation.
